[Skip to tracks](https://nearhackathon.com/#tracks)

The era of **programmable money** starts here...

Make it real on NEAR

Autonomous payments. Intelligent agents.  
**Money with a mind of its own.**

01 / BUILD DIRECTIONS

## CHOOSE YOUR  
BUILD CHANNEL

Pick a problem worth solving.  
Bring your own perspective. Build on NEAR.

[ 01 / DFI ]

Unstoppable DeFi

### Markets that never close

Build exchanges, perps, lending, vaults and trading agents that settle across chains through NEAR Intents. Deep liquidity, no custodian, nobody to switch it off.

TRADING NEAR INTENTS CHAIN SIGNATURES

[ 02 / INV ]

Investment Thesis

### Make the long-term case

Build a long-term investment thesis for NEAR and back it with data: onchain analytics, live dashboards and models anyone can re-run. Judged on the evidence, not the conviction.

ONCHAIN DATA DASHBOARDS RESEARCH

[ 03 / PRV ]

Privacy & Private AI

### Private by design

Explore confidential computation, private finance and AI that protects sensitive data. Build intelligence without exposure.

PRIVATE AI TEE NEAR AI CLOUD

[ 04 / BUS ]

Autonomous Business

### The company of one. Or none

Build AI-native businesses with treasury, sales, procurement, cross-chain payments via NEAR Intents and revenue sharing. Humans only set the constraints.

AI AGENTS NEAR INTENTS CHAIN SIGNATURES

[ 05 / SWM ]

AI Swarms

### Many agents. One economy

Build coordination markets, bidding, collective purchasing, intent-based settlement and emergent economies between agents.

MULTI-AGENT SYSTEMS NEAR INTENTS SUB-ACCOUNTS

[ 06 / SEC ]

AI Security & Defense

### Trust, but verify

Build spending limits, policy engines, sandboxed wallets, reputation and scam detection. Give AI money without giving it the keys to everything.

AGENT SECURITY FUNCTION CALL KEYS TEE ATTESTATION

[ 07 / AGT ]

Agent Economy

### Give AI a wallet

Build agents that earn, spend, negotiate, hire other agents and pay for APIs, compute or data — with crypto directly or through NEAR Intents.

AGENT COMMERCE NEAR INTENTS CHAIN SIGNATURES

[ 08 / RWM ]

Real-World Money

### Bring the boring money onchain

Build payroll, invoicing, remittances, merchant payments and stablecoin rails for real businesses. Something a normal company could use tomorrow.

STABLECOINS NEAR INTENTS META TRANSACTIONS

[ 09 / GAM ]

Games With Real Economies

### The economy is the gameplay

Build NPCs with wallets, player-owned markets and economies that evolve without a dev patch. Judged on the game loop, not the token — bonus if players never notice the chain.

AGENT NPCS SOCIAL LOGIN NEAR INTENTS NEP-245

[ 10 / NFT ]

NFTs That Do Something

### What comes after the JPEG

Build NFTs as accounts — assets that own money, earn royalties, hold inventory, carry credentials, memberships or access rights. Ownership with behavior.

DYNAMIC NFTS NEP-171 SUB-ACCOUNTS

[ 11 / MEM ]

Memecoins With Mechanics

### The joke needs rules

Build memecoins where the meme does something — supply that reacts to the community, treasuries with rules, onchain rituals and challenges. Judged on the mechanic, not the chart.

MEMECOINS TOKEN MECHANICS NEP-141

[ 12 / SOC ]

Social Money

### Coordinate value together

Build shared budgets, programmable rewards, collective ownership and reputation-based access on top of Sputnik DAO and Trezu. Don't rebuild the multisig — build what communities do with it.

SPUTNIK DAO TREZU NAMED ACCOUNTS

[ 13 / NEW ]

Open Innovation

### Something we haven't seen

Have an idea that refuses to fit a category? Explore new ways for money, intelligence and ownership to work together.

EXPERIMENTAL CHAIN ABSTRACTION BUILD YOUR OWN

02 / EXECUTION PLAN

## IDEA > BUILD >DEMO

Four stages. One thing to show for it:  
something that works.

01

### Assemble

Bring your team and choose a track. No sign-up needed to start.

02

### Build

Turn your idea into a working prototype. Test the assumptions that matter.

03

### Show it

Publish your repository and post your demo on X — tag @NEARProtocol and #NEARHackathon — with a video or screenshots of what you built.

04

### Submit

Send the form with both links: your repository and your demo post.

THE BUILDS.

Explore the projects taking shape on NEAR. Open the code. See the demo.

From your first smart contract to your next big idea. Find the guides and building blocks to make it happen on NEAR. More ecosystem resources, updated as they land:[nearbuilders.org/build](https://nearbuilders.org/build)

06 / FINAL SUBMISSION

## YOUR PROJECT.  
LANDS HERE

No sign-up to start. Build with your team or solo, then submit once before development ends, 14 Nov 2026 · 23:59 UTC.

01 Build your project. Code written since the announcement counts

04 Submit the repository link and the link to your demo post. Both are required

07 / FREQUENT QUERIES

## QUESTIONS?  
START HERE

Who can take part?
Developers, designers and people with ideas for the NEAR ecosystem. No wallet connection is needed to submit: you only enter a NEAR account address, and if you win, the prize is sent there.

Do I need a team already?
No. Build as a solo builder or with a team — one submission per project, and one person can enter up to 2 different projects, if they are independent and each README names the other one. Looking for teammates? Join the [NEAR Discord](https://discord.gg/nearprotocol) or the builders chat on [Telegram](https://t.me/nearbuilderschat) and find them there.

When does it happen?
The hackathon starts 1 Nov 2026 · 00:00 UTC. Development runs for two weeks and ends 14 Nov 2026 · 23:59 UTC, and results are announced by 18 Nov 2026 · 23:59 UTC. The full schedule is in the at-a-glance panel.

What should we submit?
A working prototype in a public repository and a public demo post on X: say you built it at NEAR HACKATHON and attach the demo video or screenshots. Send both links through the form before development ends, 14 Nov 2026 · 23:59 UTC.

I made a mistake in my submission. Can I resubmit?
Yes, no worries. Open the [Request changes](https://nearhackathon.com/request-changes) page, enter the email, NEAR wallet and repository link from your submission, tick the fields you want to change and leave your contact details. The organizers review every request by hand and may message you to confirm, especially before changing a payout wallet or a repository.

How will projects be judged?
Claude Code & Codex screen every project first: they check that it runs and does what the README says. The human judges above make the decisions. Previous NEAR hackathons evaluated technical implementation, design, impact, originality and sustainability — a good guide to prepare by.

Can I build something across multiple tracks?
Yes. Select every track your project fits in the submission form. It is still one submission per project.
